settings.engine: Stockfish 19 (every search read from the cache)
settings.nnue: default net bundled with the binary

confirmation.rootMoves: only the pass-1 top 3, the cloud's best move and the move under test
confirmation.multipv: one line per root move, so best and tested move come from one search

tiebreak.when: confirmed engine verdict and cloud verdict disagree
tiebreak.method: same restricted search as the confirmation, root moves = confirmation lines + cloud best + the move

settings.moveNotInTop3: second search with only {best move, this move} as root moves, MultiPV 2, same nodes
settings.hashPolicy: ucinewgame (hash cleared) before each new position; kept between the searches of one position
settings.scores: centipawns from the side to move, clamped to +-1000; mate = +-1000 (Lichess convention)
settings.winPercent: 50 + 50*(2/(1+exp(-0.00368208*cp))-1)  (lila WinPercent); a win-chance point = 1 on this 0-100 scale
settings.lichessLabels: inaccuracy >= 5, mistake >= 10, blunder >= 15 win-chance points lost (lila Advice: 0.1/0.2/0.3)

cloud.params: fen, multiPv=3 (fallback multiPv=1 when the 3-line entry is missing)
cloud.notStored: a 404 is cached only after a stored position answered 200 in the same run
cloud.moveNotInCloudLines: eval of the position after the move (its best line, negated); if missing, a lower bound from the third cloud line

settings.determinism: Threads > 1 makes Stockfish non-deterministic: re-runs can differ by a few cp and, rarely, in the move order of close lines.
settings.cacheLookup: a stored search of the same position, node count, MultiPV and root moves is reused whatever thread count and hash size it was made with (the first one stored wins)
